import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    INSTALLED_APPS=['django.contrib.contenttypes', 'django.contrib.auth', 'testing'],
    DATABASES={'default': {'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.sqlite3', 'NAME': ':memory:'}},
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD='django.db.models.AutoField',
)
django.setup()

from django.db import models
from django.utils.translation import gettext_lazy as _


class MyChoice(models.TextChoices):
    FIRST_CHOICE = "first", _("The first choice, it is")
    SECOND_CHOICE = "second", _("The second choice, it is")


class MyChoiceInt(models.IntegerChoices):
    FIRST = 1, "First"
    SECOND = 2, "Second"


class MyObject(models.Model):
    my_str_value = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=MyChoice.choices)
    my_int_value = models.IntegerField(choices=MyChoiceInt.choices)

    class Meta:
        app_label = 'testing'


from django.test.utils import setup_test_environment, get_runner
from django.test import TestCase

setup_test_environment()
runner = get_runner(settings)()
old_config = runner.setup_databases()


class EnumTest(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.my_object = MyObject.objects.create(
            my_str_value=MyChoice.FIRST_CHOICE, my_int_value=MyChoiceInt.FIRST
        )

    def test_created_object_is_str(self):
        my_object = self.my_object
        assert isinstance(my_object.my_str_value, str), type(my_object.my_str_value)
        assert str(my_object.my_str_value) == "first", str(my_object.my_str_value)
        assert isinstance(my_object.my_int_value, int), type(my_object.my_int_value)
        assert str(my_object.my_int_value) == "1", str(my_object.my_int_value)

    def test_retrieved_object_is_str(self):
        my_object = MyObject.objects.last()
        assert isinstance(my_object.my_str_value, str), type(my_object.my_str_value)
        assert str(my_object.my_str_value) == "first", str(my_object.my_str_value)
        assert isinstance(my_object.my_int_value, int), type(my_object.my_int_value)
        assert str(my_object.my_int_value) == "1", str(my_object.my_int_value)


import unittest
suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(EnumTest)
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
runner.teardown_databases(old_config)
raise SystemExit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() else 1)
